items.description: morning sky, blue to peach, with drifting cumulus clouds
sun low over five hazy ridges, purple to orange sky
open sea to the horizon under a pale sky, with swell and glitter
out-of-focus golden lights drifting on a dark warm ground
out-of-focus street lights passing at night, reflected on a wet road

sun rays through blurred foliage and trunks, floating dust
a glass bottle and a sphere on a pedestal in a peach studio set, slow push-in
orange and magenta film light leaks moving over black
confetti falling in front of violet party lights
cream paper with fibres and grain
